concepts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE polished Google Play screenshot concept for the Bosnian prayer-times app Vaktija. This is visual direction exploration, but it should look like a finished premium store listing. Use the supplied real timetable screenshot as the primary screen insert, preserving its UI layout, illustrated prayer icons, Bosnian labels, and prayer times. Do not invent UI controls, features or data. Preserve the screenshot's proportions, and remove only Android notification/status bar and bottom gesture bar from the screen insert. No Chrome branding. Device: a thin realistic generic Android phone bezel, NO Apple notch or Dynamic Island. All headline text must be crisp, beautifully typeset, correctly accented Bosnian. Keep the actual app timetable large and readable. No Google Play badges, no download buttons, no ratings, no watermarks, no concept numbers.
OUTPUT: exactly 1080 x 1920 px, 9:16 PORTRAIT. Input image 1 is the actual Vaktija dark timetable to embed faithfully. Input image 2 is ONLY a reference for overall premium store composition: large headline, dark jewel-tone tactile background, warm metallic slim phone frame. Do not use any Rummy branding, cards or gaming imagery. DIRECTION: EMERALD AND GOLD HERO. Deep forest-green subtly embossed Islamic geometric pattern, a restrained gold glow at upper left, refined hairline gold corner ornaments. Small spaced gold wordmark at top: "VAKTIJA". Centered oversized elegant ivory serif headline on two lines, exact: "Svaki namaz." / "Na vrijeme." Smaller clear ivory subtitle exact: "Vaktija za vaš grad." Below, one very large straight-on phone with restrained champagne-gold edge filling lower 69% of the canvas. Its display contains the actual dark timetable, with illustrated mosque countdown panel and all timetable rows visible if possible. The UI must remain the hero, not be tiny or obscured. Elegant atmospheric rich materials with controlled ornament, no clutter. This should feel like Vaktija, not a game.
